representative_scale.selection: All published PINDER-S cases with both apo monomers; freeze sorted IDs and index hash before execution.
representative_scale.candidate_count_basis: Fixed intake design supported by published FRODOCK --nc 100 example, not verified PINDER paper setting.
representative_scale.reason: Real unbound protein docking on full prioritized stratum; no toy extrapolation or doubling loop.

required: Corresponding native dimers and residue mappings
Fixed candidate count and method configuration
Independent random seeds for any stochastic method
inputs.reason: Complete input manifest, seeds, executable external software and configuration unavailable; do not launch until resolved.
inputs.challenge: 6IHB/6JCQ/6JCS separated-component redocking remains a separate challenge; assembly/chain selection unresolved.

outputs.poses: results_dir/frodock/<pinder_id>/apo_decoys/model_<rank>.pdb; each model has receptor R and ligand L chains.
outputs.scoring_interface: pinder_eval --eval_dir eval_dir; source pinder.eval.run.main writes <method_name>_metrics.csv and <method_name>_leaderboard.csv.
required_analysis: Rank-1 DockQ and best-of-100 DockQ, each with iRMS and Fnat
Fraction of all fixed cases reaching DockQ >=0.23, separately rank-1 and best-of-100
Per-case wall time, throughput, time to first acceptable pose, CPU/GPU peak memory, hardware and cost evidence
Missing/failed cases, actual generated candidate counts, seed/config/input hashes
outputs.note: Brief DockQ threshold must be applied explicitly to metrics CSV; stock leaderboard CAPRI_rank is not an identical criterion.

timing_scope.primary: Per-case wall time from prepared apo files through potential-map creation, exhaustive search, clustering, ranked coordinate generation and result writing. Report scoring time separately.
separate: Cold versus cached preprocessing where measured
timing_scope.throughput: Actual evaluated/generated poses divided by measured search wall time; report actual search counts separately from 100 retained clusters.
timing_scope.time_to_acceptable: Needs time-stamped candidate availability and post hoc native scoring; final batch outputs alone cannot establish first-hit time within search.
timing_scope.cost: Actual billed compute cost from measured duration and supplied price evidence.
timing_scope.reason: No hardware price, measured runtime or candidate trace supplied.

budget_reason: No representative timing measurements; cannot assert 93-case run finishes within default method_run budget. No workload, build, scale search or benchmark script executed.
gate_scripts_reason: No gate script paths or commands were named in prompt or brief. Only JSON structural validation performed.
blockers: FroDock source archive required by the published baseline Dockerfile was not obtained; its linked download page returned HTTP 404. Public chaconlab/FRODOCK repository tree inspected contains documentation and assets, not executable source.

Published PINDER method runner uses pandas.from_csv, and FroDock adapter contains apparent path concatenation and wildcard shutil.copy defects. These are source-inspection findings, not reproduction results.
No immutable pin or hash for the external FroDock software archive was established.
All 93 paired-apo input files and their mappings were not individually verified. Published README warns that archives omit some manifest files.
Representative runtime, peak CPU/GPU memory, fixed repeat count, and independent seed values are unavailable; no build or workload was run.
